Package gooeygui

Class CheckBox

java.lang.Object
gooeygui.Component
gooeygui.CheckBox
public class CheckBox extends Component
A box with a text label that the user can check or uncheck. Each check box works independently; to let the user pick only one option from a group, use RadioButton and RadioGroup instead. 

 CheckBox extraCheese = new CheckBox("Extra cheese", 50, 100, 150, 30);
 extraCheese.setOnChange(this::updatePrice);
 window.addComponent(extraCheese);

  • Constructor Details

    • CheckBox

      public CheckBox(String text, int x, int y, int width, int height)
      Constructs an unchecked check box with a text label.
      Parameters:
      text - the text displayed next to the box
      x - the x-coordinate of the top-left corner, in pixels
      y - the y-coordinate of the top-left corner, in pixels
      width - the width of the check box and its label, in pixels (at least 1)
      height - the height of the check box, in pixels (at least 1)
      Throws:
      GooeyGUIException - if text is null, or if width or height is less than 1
